## Spec

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `spec.connectionRef` | string | no | `"default"` | connectionRef is the name of the ZitiConnection to use. It defaults to "default". |
| `spec.deletionPolicy` | string | no | `"Delete"` | deletionPolicy Delete removes the Ziti entities when this resource is deleted. Orphan removes only the operator tags and keeps the entities. It cannot change after creation. One of: `Delete`, `Orphan`. |
| `spec.edgeRouters` | list of string | no |  | edgeRouters are router names. When set, an edge router policy gives the identities access to them. |
| `spec.identityRoles` | list of string | yes |  | identityRoles select the identities that may dial. Roles follow the connection roleScope. Minimum items 1. |
| `spec.postureCheckRoles` | list of string | no |  | postureCheckRoles add posture checks to the Dial policy. |
| `spec.serviceRoles` | list of string | yes |  | serviceRoles select the services they may dial. Roles follow the connection roleScope. Minimum items 1. |
| `spec.zitiName` | string | no |  | zitiName defaults to &lt;namespace&gt;.&lt;name&gt;. The Dial policy is &lt;zitiName&gt;.dial and the router policy is &lt;zitiName&gt;.erp. Minimum length 1. Maximum length 1000. |

## Validation rules

The API server rejects a resource that breaks one of these rules.

- `spec`: zitiName is immutable
- `spec`: deletionPolicy is immutable

## Example

```yaml
apiVersion: alialjaffer.ziti/v1alpha1
kind: ZitiAccessPolicy
metadata:
  name: team-a
  namespace: default
spec:
  connectionRef: default
  identityRoles: ["#team-a"]
  serviceRoles: ["#team-a"]
  edgeRouters: [router-a]
```
